candidates.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay’s assets row: ‘ ₹30 crore not disclosed, will it matter to voters?’ — All about case in Madras HC
candidates.excerpt: The Madras High Court questioned whether non-disclosure of assets worth ₹30 crore by Chief Minister Joseph Vijay in his election nomination papers would amount to “corrupt practice.”

candidates.title: 'Zero transparency, zero accountability from EC', alleges YouTuber Dhruv Rathee addressing SIR protest in Bengaluru
candidates.excerpt: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee accused the Election Commission of lacking transparency and accountability over the SIR exercise at a protest in Bengaluru. Actor-activist Prakash Raj called for the exercise to be scrapped, saying it threatened citizens’ rights and dignity.

candidates.title: BRS cadres block highway over power outages in Mancherial
candidates.excerpt: BRS cadres staged a rasta-roko in Bheemaram of Mancherial district over alleged unscheduled power outages in Chennur constituency. They said erratic supply was affecting farmers and crops, blocked the Nizamabad-Jagdalpur highway and were detained by local police.

candidates.title: India condemns Houthi attacks targeting Saudi Arabia airports, civilian deaths as ‘completely unacceptable’
candidates.excerpt: India's remarks came after three people reportedly died and 36 others were injured following the strikes on Abha International Airport and King Khalid International Airport that took place separately on October 6 and 7.

candidates.title: Setback for MLC Anantha Babu In Supreme Court
candidates.excerpt: YSRCP MLC Anantha Babu and his wife Lakshmi Durga, the main accused in the murder of Dalit driver V. Subrahmanyam in Kakinada, suffered a setback in the Supreme Court.

candidates.title: Bengaluru: Petrol Pump Catches Fire After Jaguar Car Crashes Into It
candidates.excerpt: A Jaguar car rammed into a fuel station in Bengaluru, sparking a massive fire. The occupants of the car and the fuel station staff narrowly escaped with their lives, while a worker was injured in the fire.

candidates.title: Nana Patekar dies at 75: ‘I am a good shooter’ - When actor recalled spending 60 days with Indian Army during Kargil War
candidates.excerpt: During the 1999 Kargil War, Nana Patekar had spent around 60 days with soldiers. He had previously discussed it in a 2024 interview and shared that he was part of the QRT (Quick Reaction Team) in Kargil.

candidates.title: Chennai Corporation Installs High-Capacity Pumps at 45 Flood-Prone Areas
candidates.excerpt: The Corporation has allocated Rs 100 crore for desilting drains, removing water hyacinth from water bodies, road maintenance, preparing relief camps and community kitchens
